query: SELECT unitNumber, CHAR_LENGTH(overview) as overview_chars, CHAR_LENGTH(grammarExplained) as grammar_chars, CHAR_LENGTH(practiceExamples) as practice_chars, (CHAR_LENGTH(overview) + CHAR_LENGTH(grammarExplained) + CHAR_LENGTH(practiceExamples)) as total_chars FROM unitExplanations WHERE unitNumber BETWEEN 1 AND 5 ORDER BY unitNumber
